 How To Do GTA 6 Infinite Money Glitch
 Money makes the world go round in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but getting your hands on it can be a bit of a grind, particularly during the early stages of the campaign. Fortunately, players have already discovered an infinite money glitch that lets you repeatedly collect and sell valuable loot for a pretty sizeable payday.
 To be clear, this isn’t going to make you a millionaire overnight. You’re not going to see stacks of cash magically appearing in front of you, but if you follow the method correctly, you can earn around $10,000 per run. That’s certainly not a bad return for a little bit of effort.
 So, if you’re looking to give your bank balance a much-needed boost, here’s how to complete the infinite money glitch in GTA 6.
 You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already!
 When Can You Do The Infinite Money Glitch In GTA 6?
 Image by Insider Gaming. 
 We recommend waiting until you’ve completed Chapter 1 before attempting the GTA 6 infinite money glitch. 
 You’re welcome to try it earlier if you’re desperate for some extra cash, but without getting into any major spoilers, you’ll have a much better opportunity to make the most of the method once you’ve progressed further into the campaign.
 Related: GTA 6 Sex & Romance—How To Have Sex In GTA 6 
 If you do decide to take advantage of the glitch before reaching Chapter 2, we’d recommend spending any money you’ve accumulated before starting the mission ‘Tourist Trap’—that’s all we’ll say on the matter.
 How To Do The Infinite Money Glitch In GTA 6
 Image by DayOne. 
 To do the infinite money glitch in GTA 6, you’ll need to head to this spot on the map, northeast of Hamlet. 
 Here, you’ll find a red barn that you can enter, which appears to be abandoned at first glance. Inside, however, is a small office containing several bundles of valuable illicit goods. These are what you’ll need to collect to make the glitch work.
 Related: How To Break Into Military Base In GTA 6—Mile Zero Air Station Location 
 Here’s a step-by-step breakdown of the entire process:
 Head to the red barn marked on the map above, northeast of Hamlet.
 Enter the barn and head into the small office, where you’ll find several cocaine bags. Collect all of them and place them into your stash bag.
 Take your stash bag outside and put it in the trunk of your vehicle.
 Head back inside the barn and look for the van in the middle. You’ll find another stash bag containing cash, which you can use to collect the remaining cocaine.
 Continue collecting the available loot until you’ve accumulated four stash bags in your vehicle.
 Once all four bags are secured, save your game. This is the most important step, so make sure you create a save before continuing.
 Reload the save you just created. You’ll respawn back at home, with your vehicle still carrying all of your previously collected stash bags.
 Take your collected goods to any Fence and sell them for a tidy profit.
 Return to the same barn, where all of the loot should have respawned.
 Save your game again, reload, and return to the barn to collect the respawned loot once more.
 And that’s all there is to it! While you’ll need to repeat the process a fair few times if you’re hoping to become a millionaire, earning around $10,000 per run makes this a pretty lucrative way to build up your bank balance .
 A big shout-out to DayOne for discovering and sharing the method.
